description: Authoritative per-target language-dialect policy (RFC 0006 M0 / roadmap R03). By user decision (2026-09-22) every in-tree C++ target compiles as C++20: unmigrated code uses cxx20-permissive, new and migrated code the strict cxx20 dialect. legacy-cxx11 exists only for fixtures that stand in for frozen external consumers (prebuilt mods/plugins) of the declared C++11 facades; no in-tree target may select it. The Waf tool scripts/waifulib/toolchain_dialect.py applies or verifies the policy for every C/C++ task generator and records final invocations; tools/quality/toolchain_boundary.py verifies them. Target wscripts do not pass -std flags. Include and link permissions are owned by architecture/modules.json, not here.

cxx20-permissive.description: Default for unmigrated in-tree C++: C++20 supplied by the root wscript with the engine's historical -fpermissive relaxation. Verified, never rewritten, so each target keeps its exact flags.

cxx20.description: New and deliberately migrated first-party targets: exactly one C++20 flag and no permissive compilation, whatever the inherited flags were.

cxx20-vendored-ivp.description: The vendored IVP physics submodule (ivp/, pinned; not edited here) compiled as C++20 with the engine's permissive relaxation. Its sources still use the `register` storage class, which C++17 removed; -Wno-register accepts it on clang (gcc already only warns). Retire when IVP simulation retires (R44/R45) or the submodule is updated.

legacy-cxx11.description: Frozen external consumer dialect: exact C++11 code built outside this tree (mods, plugins, SDK users) that includes the declared legacy facades. GNU-family fixture units only; MSVC cannot select exact C++11. No in-tree target may select it.

c-toolchain-default.description: Legacy C targets keep whatever the toolchain and their own configuration select; recorded in evidence, not constrained.

box3d-c17.description: Private pinned Box3D C17 library (RFC 0004/0006): gnu17 with upstream's floating-point, visibility and PIC settings and none of the engine's fast-math flags. No MSVC mapping is declared, so an MSVC Box3D build fails composition instead of guessing.

abi.rule: Every C++ target linked into one binary resolves the same libstdc++ dual-ABI value. Engine products define _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=0 globally; strict-hygiene compositions (strict_cpp20_env) use the toolchain default and link only each other.

supported_combinations.description: A legacy-cxx11 consumer and a cxx20 provider built by the same compiler and libstdc++ in one configuration, sharing the product's dual-ABI value, communicating only through declared legacy facades (vtables, C++11 standard-layout values, std::function).
Strict-hygiene cxx20 targets built with the toolchain-default dual-ABI value, linked only with other targets of the same value.

unsupported_combinations: Different compilers or standard libraries within one product binary or loaded module set
Different _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI values on either side of any linked boundary
Standard-library containers, smart pointers, Expected or exceptions across a legacy facade (RFC 0006)
